fields.statement: Verifier at 7e0092cc (commit adds only the builder's actor record; no code). Ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(workflow-plan-autonomy|workflow-stage-autonomy|stage-autonomy|plan-workflow-autonomous|plan-workflow-autonomous-left|autonomy-accept-rule)$': all PASS, with fake rex and agents. Read the scripts against the acceptance: workflow-plan-autonomy covers plan.toml autonomous=true starting the request's plan run --autonomous under rhiza.autonomy.plan=owner, plan=owner starting it without under auto, and a ship-change plan=auto leaving plan runs unchanged; workflow-stage-autonomy covers ship=auto starting a ready change set under ship=owner, signoff=owner starting run start without --autonomous under signoff=auto, plan=auto not affecting ship, and accept=owner (both a custom workflow and a plan.toml override) leaving drafts proposed under accept=auto; stage-autonomy passes unchanged for the no-declaration fallback.
